status: completed two-seed generated protein48 and complex64 comparisons
contrast: placement minus same-parameter interleaved control; negative errors favor placement

protein48.interpretation: Replicated joint bond/MSD/position-distance path gains against the matched control. Seed72 RMSF and increment-path confidence intervals include zero. Both seeds still worse than released PVB on protein bonds, MSD and RMSF; do not equate partial improvements with competitive parity.

complex_new48.interpretation: RMSF regression repeats despite seed72 bond/pocket improvements. Seed71 broad bond interval is not noninferiority. Seed72 center-path score beats PVB on new48, but this does not establish all-metric or replicated superiority.

decision: Retain evidence for protein gains, but do not merge as a universally beneficial architecture. No placement-position sweep at present.
limitations: Repeated development panels, not independent sealed tests
Per-system intervals do not include training-seed uncertainty
